words.root_logic: al-（ad 向着）+ leg（lex 法条、legare 依法举出）→ 向法庭举出一条说法，只是举出，未经证实
words.origin: 古法语 alleguer ← 拉丁语 allegare（ad- 向 + legare 依法举出、派遣），与 lex（法条）同支；英语词形另受古法语 eslegier（ex- + litigare 打官司）牵引，义则承 allegare
words.native_definition: to state something as true or as a fact without giving proof
words.core_concept: put forward a claim without proof – 举出一条未经证实的说法
words.core_image: 他把一页纸举过头顶，说上面写着凭据，却始终不肯递给旁边的人看
examples: The report alleges that officials took bribes.
She is alleged to have forged the receipts.
semantic_expansions: 声称：把一件事当成事实说出来，但不出示凭据
断言：语气笃定，不留余地，正误另说
指控：把这条说法对着某人举出，指他做过某事
collocations: allege that + 从句 —— 声称某事，后接完整从句，不接不定式
be alleged to do sth —— 据称做过某事，被动式比主动式常见
alleged sth —— 所谓的某事物，置于名词前表这一说法未经证实

words.root_logic: ap-（ad 向着）+ pend（pendere 悬挂）→ 挂在主体上的一小截，本体缺了它照样完整
words.origin: 拉丁语 appendix（附加物）← appendere（ad- 向 + pendere 悬挂）
words.native_definition: an extra section at the end of a book, or the small tube attached to the intestine
words.core_concept: a small part hung on the end of the main body – 挂在主体末端的一小截
words.core_image: 正文完了还剩十几页，全是表格和原始记录，翻不翻都不影响前面读懂
examples: The full data appear in the appendix.
His appendix burst and he needed surgery.
semantic_expansions: 附录：正文之后另附的材料，供查证而非必读
附件：不在主体之内、另外挂上的一份东西
盲肠：肠道上垂着的一小段细管，切掉不妨碍消化

words.root_logic: a-（ad 向着）+ gree（拉丁 gratum 合意的东西）+ -able → 正合对方心意，因而对得上、答得下
words.origin: 古法语 agreable ← agreer（合心意）← 通俗拉丁语 *aggratare ← 拉丁语 gratus（受欢迎的、合意的）
words.native_definition: pleasant, or willing to accept a suggestion
words.core_concept: falling in with what pleases – 正落在合心意的那一边
words.core_image: 茶温刚好，座位靠窗不晒，对面的人提什么他都点头，一下午过得没一处别扭
examples: We spent an agreeable evening by the fire.
He was agreeable to the new plan.
semantic_expansions: 令人愉快的：与人相处让人舒服，不生摩擦
宜人的：环境温度气候恰好，待着不难受
欣然同意的：对方的提法正对上自己的意思，痛快答应
collocations: be agreeable to sth —— 乐于接受某项提议，介词固定 to
be agreeable to sb —— 对某人来说可以接受，主语多为方案而非人

words.root_logic: al-（ad 向着）+ low（拉丁 locare 安置、划归）+ -ance → 划到你名下的那一份
words.origin: 古法语 aloance ← aloer ← 拉丁语 allocare（ad- 向 + locare 安置、划归）；古法语另有同形的 aloer ← allaudare（ad- + laudare 称许），两支在中古英语里合并，「许可」一义出自后者
words.native_definition: an amount of money or a quantity officially given or permitted
words.core_concept: the share allocated to you – 划归到你名下的那一份
words.core_image: 每月一号账上多出一笔固定的数，合同上写明只能有这么多，超出的自己掏
examples: His travel allowance covers taxis and meals.
The children get a weekly allowance.
semantic_expansions: 津贴：单位按名目发下的一笔钱，用途有限定
零用钱：家里定期给的一小笔，随自己花
限额：规定内可有的数量，行李免费额就是这个
折让：结算时准许扣掉的一部分
collocations: make allowances for sth —— 把某情况考虑进去、予以体谅，固定用复数
an allowance of sth —— 某物的定量份额，of 后接数量或物

words.root_logic: ar-（ad 向着）+ rest（拉丁 restare 停住，re- 回 + stare 站立）→ 让人当场站住不许再动
words.origin: 古法语 arester ← 通俗拉丁语 *arrestare ← 拉丁语 restare（停下不走，re- 回 + stare 站立）
words.native_definition: to stop someone by legal authority and take them away, or to stop a process
words.core_concept: made to stand still on the spot – 当场被按住不再动
words.core_image: 两个人一边一个按住他胳膊，手腕上一声轻响，他就再没往前迈出一步
examples: Police arrested two men at the airport.
The drug arrests the growth of tumours.
semantic_expansions: 逮捕：执法者按住人并带走，凭的是法上的权
拘留：带走之后先关一段时间，未必已定罪
阻止：把正在走的过程按住，不让它继续
中止：势头本在往前，到此停下
collocations: under arrest —— 处于被拘押状态，固定不加冠词
arrest sb for sth —— 因某事逮捕某人，缘由用 for

words.root_logic: ampli-（拉丁 amplus 宽大）+ -fy（facere 做）→ 做得更宽大：声音、力道、说法都能撑开
words.origin: 古法语 amplifier ← 拉丁语 amplificare（amplus 宽大 + facere 做）
words.native_definition: to make something louder, stronger, or more detailed
words.core_concept: made wider and stronger – 做得更宽、更足
words.core_image: 旋钮往右一转，原先听不清的呼吸声变得满屋都是，连纸页翻动都清清楚楚
examples: The speakers amplify her voice across the field.
Please amplify that point in your report.
semantic_expansions: 放大：把信号或声音的量做大，听得见看得清
增强：使效果或影响更有力，不限于声音
详述：把话说得更展开，补足细节
collocations: amplify on sth —— 就某点进一步展开说明，介词固定 on

words.root_logic: bene（好）+ fit（facere 做）→ 做下的一件好事，落到谁手上就成了谁的所得
words.origin: 古法语 bienfet ← 拉丁语 benefactum（做下的好事）← bene（好）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: an advantage gained from something, or to gain such an advantage
words.core_concept: a good thing done that lands in your hands – 做下的好事落到自己手里
words.core_image: 换了新路线以后，他每天早上多睡二十分钟，车费也比原先省下一半
examples: Both sides gained real benefit from the deal.
Small farms benefit most from the subsidy.
semantic_expansions: 好处：实实在在得到的便利，能算得出
益处：对身体或长远有帮助，未必立刻见效
福利：单位或政府按制度给的待遇
受益：作动词时指自己成了得好处的一方
collocations: benefit from sth —— 从某事中得益，介词固定 from，也可用 by
be of benefit to sb —— 对某人有益，名词式，比 benefit sb 正式
for the benefit of sb —— 为了某人的利益，多用于书面

words.root_logic: act（拉丁 agere 驱动、做，过去分词 actus）+ -ress（表女性）→ 在台上做出一个人来的女子
words.origin: 英语 actor 加表女性的后缀 -ress 构成，actor ← 拉丁语 actor（做事的人）← agere（驱动、做）
words.native_definition: a woman who performs a part in a play or film
words.core_concept: a woman who acts out a part – 把一个角色做出来的女子
words.core_image: 她在台上抖着声念别人的词，散场后擦掉脸上的油彩，又是原来那个人
examples: The actress won an award for that role.
Three actresses tried out for the part.

words.root_logic: ap-（ad 向着）+ pli（plicare 折叠、贴合）+ -ance → 贴到活儿上去派用场的那件东西
words.origin: 英语 apply 加后缀 -ance 构成，apply ← 古法语 aplier ← 拉丁语 applicare（ad- 贴上 + plicare 折叠）
words.native_definition: a machine or device made to do a particular job in the home
words.core_concept: a thing put to a job – 贴到活儿上去用的那件东西
words.core_image: 台面上一排插着电的东西，每样只干一件事，烤的只管烤，搅的只管搅
examples: The kitchen came with all the appliances.
This appliance must be earthed properly.
semantic_expansions: 器具：为某一件活儿做出来的用具
家用电器：家里插电用的成套机器
装置：装上去起某个作用的一套东西

words.root_logic: audi（audire 听）→ 拉丁语第一人称「我听」，二十世纪初拿来指信号里管耳朵那一路，与管眼睛的 video 相对
words.origin: 拉丁语 audio（我听）← audire（听），二十世纪初进入英语作构词成分
words.native_definition: relating to sound that is recorded or transmitted
words.core_concept: the hearing side of a signal – 信号里走耳朵那一路
words.core_image: 画面那一格黑着，进度条还在走，说话人的声气一句不落地传出来
examples: The audio on this recording is very clear.
Check the audio before the lecture starts.
semantic_expansions: 音频的：与录下或传出的声响有关的
声音的：设备上专管声响的那一路
声音部分：一段影像里单独拆出的听觉内容

words.root_logic: a-（ad 向着）+ vail（valere 有力、值）+ -able（可…的）→ 还值当、还使得上，因而拿得到手
words.origin: 英语 avail 加后缀 -able 构成，avail ← 古法语 vail-（valoir 值）← 拉丁语 valere（有力、有价值）
words.native_definition: able to be got, used, or seen, or free to meet someone
words.core_concept: there and still good to use – 在手边而且还使得上
words.core_image: 售票窗口的灯还亮着，前面没人排队，里头的人抬头看了他一眼
examples: Tickets are still available at the door.
The doctor is not available until Monday.
semantic_expansions: 可用的：就在手边，随时能派上用场
可得到的：按正常途径能拿到，不必特批
有空的：人腾出了时间，能接待或参加
collocations: be available to sb —— 可供某人使用或取得，介词用 to
be available for sth —— 可用于某场合或某目的，介词用 for

words.origin: 古法语 abundance ← 拉丁语 abundantia ← abundare（漫出来，ab- 自…而出 + undare 起浪 ← unda 波浪）
words.native_definition: a very large quantity of something, more than enough
words.core_concept: more than the container can hold – 多到盛不住而漫出来
words.core_image: 筐里的桃子堆到边沿还往下滚，摊主又倒进一簸箕，脚边散了一地
examples: The region has an abundance of clean water.
Wild flowers grow here in abundance.
semantic_expansions: 丰富：品类多、分量足，不显紧张
大量：单论数目就远超所需
充裕：供得上还有余，用着宽松
collocations: in abundance —— 大量地，作状语后置于动词之后
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 academie ← 拉丁语 academia ← 希腊语 Akademeia：雅典城外的一片林苑，得名于英雄 Akademos，柏拉图在此讲学
words.native_definition: a school for special training, or a society of scholars and artists
words.core_concept: a grove set aside for learning – 专划出来做学问的一处地方
words.core_image: 城外一片树林里摆着石凳，年轻人围坐着，老人讲一上午，讲完各自散去
examples: She trained at a naval academy for four years.
The academy elected him last spring.
semantic_expansions: 学院：专教某一门本事的学校
研究院：专做研究的机构
学会：同行学者结成的团体
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 accumulatus（accumulare 的过去分词）← ad-（向着）+ cumulare（堆起）← cumulus（土堆）
words.native_definition: to gather more and more of something over a period of time
words.core_concept: one layer heaped on the last – 一层压一层地堆上去
words.core_image: 窗台拐角半年没擦，灰一层压一层，指头一划就现出一道深色的沟
examples: He accumulated a large debt over two years.
Dust accumulates behind the radiator.
semantic_expansions: 积累：一点一点添上去，日子越久越多
积聚：分散的东西慢慢汇到一处
堆积：实物摞在一处，占着地方
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 additionalis ← 拉丁语 additio（添进去）← addere（添上，ad- 向着 + -dere 置入）
words.native_definition: extra, beyond what was already there or planned
words.core_concept: one more put onto what is there – 在原有的之上再添一份
words.core_image: 六把椅子已经围满了，服务员又从墙边搬来两把塞进缝里，人才坐得下
examples: We need two additional chairs for the table.
There is no additional charge for delivery.
semantic_expansions: 额外的：超出原定数目之外又添的
附加的：本不在主体里，另外挂上的一项
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 alumen（明矾）→ alumina（矾土），Davy 1808 年造 alumium，1812 年改作 aluminum，英国后定名 aluminium
words.native_definition: a light silver-white metal that does not rust
words.core_concept: a light metal that keeps its shine – 又轻又不生锈的一种金属
words.core_image: 一只锅拎起来轻得不像话，敲一下声音发闷，搁了几年也不见一处锈斑
examples: The frame is made of aluminum tubing.
Aluminum cans are easy to recycle.
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 applaudere（ad- 向着 + plaudere 拍打、击掌）
words.native_definition: to clap your hands to show approval, or to praise something publicly
words.core_concept: hands struck together toward someone – 冲着人把两只手拍在一起
words.core_image: 最后一个音落下，满屋巴掌拍得响成一片，前排几个人站了起来
examples: The audience applauded for a full minute.
Critics applauded her decision to resign.
semantic_expansions: 鼓掌：两手相拍，不出声也算
喝彩：一边拍一边出声叫好
称赞：公开表示赞许，不必真拍手
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 assimilatus（assimilare/assimulare 的过去分词）← ad-（向着）+ similis（相像）
words.native_definition: to take something in completely, or to become like the people around you
words.core_concept: made like what surrounds it – 变得和周围的一样
words.core_image: 新来的孩子头一天贴着墙站，一个月后口音和玩法跟同学分不出来
examples: Children assimilate new words very fast.
Immigrants gradually assimilated into local life.
semantic_expansions: 同化：把外来的一方变成和自己一样
吸收：把外面的东西完全收进来变成自己的
融入：自己变得与周围无从分辨
collocations: assimilate into sth —— 融入某个群体，介词固定 into
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 astronomie ← 拉丁语 astronomia ← 希腊语 astron（星）+ nomos（法则）：星体运行所循的规矩
words.native_definition: the scientific study of the stars, planets, and space
words.core_concept: the rules the stars move by – 星体运行所循的规矩
words.core_image: 凌晨三点守在镜筒后头，记下那个亮点每夜挪开的角度，一年记满一本
examples: He studied astronomy at a small college.
Modern astronomy relies on huge telescopes.
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 希腊语 automatos（自行动作的）← autos（自己）+ -matos（与 menos 心意、动念同支），英语加 -ic 构成
words.native_definition: working by itself without a person operating it, or happening as a certain result
words.core_concept: moving of its own accord – 自己就动起来，不用人推
words.core_image: 门看见有人走近就自己滑开，人过去了又合上，一整天没谁伸手推过
examples: The gate is automatic and opens at dusk.
His reaction was almost automatic.
semantic_expansions: 自动的：机器自行运转，无须人操作
无意识的：反应快到来不及想，身体自己做了
必然的：条件一满足就随之而来，不另作决定
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中古英语 aboute ← 古英语 onbūtan（on 在 + be 靠 + ūtan 外面）：绕着外圈
words.native_definition: on the subject of something, or approximately, or in many directions
words.core_concept: circling round the outside of something – 绕着一样东西的外圈
words.core_image: 一群人围着桌上那张图站成一圈，手指头都点在同一块地方
examples: We talked about the plan for an hour.
There were about fifty people inside.
semantic_expansions: 关于：话头绕着某件事转，那件事就是内容
大约：数目在那个数附近打转，不落实
到处：在四周各处，没有定向
collocations: be about to do sth —— 即将做某事，指眼前马上就要发生
what/how about doing sth —— 提议或征询意见，后接动名词
be about sth —— 内容是关于某事，主语多为书、片、话
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 geforðian（推向前、办成，ge- 完成 + forðian ← forð 向前），十六世纪拼作 af-，因当时误以为它含拉丁 ad-
words.native_definition: to have enough money or ability for something
words.core_concept: having enough to carry it – 手里够得上这笔担子
words.core_image: 他把标价看了三遍，又算了算这月剩下的数，最后把东西放回架子
examples: We cannot afford a new car this year.
The hill affords a fine view of the bay.
semantic_expansions: 买得起：钱数够，付得出这个价
负担得起：时间精力或代价担得下来
提供：把条件或机会拿得出来给人
collocations: afford sth —— 负担得起某物，后接名词
can/could afford to do sth —— 有条件做某事，接不定式而非动名词
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语复合词 after + noon：after ← 古英语 æfter（在…之后），noon ← 古英语 nōn（正午），nōn 本身借自拉丁语 nona hora（第九个钟点）
words.native_definition: the part of the day between midday and evening
words.core_concept: the stretch of daylight past midday – 正午之后那一段白天
words.core_image: 日头过了顶往西斜，阳光横着照进屋，桌腿的影子一寸寸拉长，人开始发困
examples: She sleeps for an hour every afternoon.
The meeting ran late into the afternoon.
collocations: in the afternoon —— 在下午，泛指时段用 in
on + 星期 + afternoon —— 指明哪一天的下午时改用 on
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 agenes（again 加副词性属格 -es）← 古英语 ongegn（on 在 + gegn 正对面），词尾 -t 后来仿 amongst、whilst 加上
words.native_definition: in opposition to something, or touching and pressing on something
words.core_concept: facing straight into something – 正对着一样东西顶上去
words.core_image: 风迎面吹来，他身子前倾，压低帽檐，一步一步顶着往前走
examples: Most members voted against the new rule.
He leaned his bike against the wall.
semantic_expansions: 反对：立场正对着对方，不同意
靠着：身体或物件抵在某个面上
逆着：与风向水流的来势相对而行
collocations: be against sth/doing sth —— 反对某事，接名词或动名词
lean sth against sth —— 把某物靠在某处，指抵触面
against the law —— 违法，固定搭配不加冠词
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 英语复合词 along + side：along ← 古英语 andlang（and- 正对着 + lang 长），side ← 古英语 sīde（侧面）
words.native_definition: next to and parallel with something, or working together with someone
words.core_concept: lying flush along the side – 长边贴着长边
words.core_image: 小船靠上码头，船身和木板边沿贴得齐平，前后都没探出去
examples: The boat lay alongside the stone quay.
She worked alongside three other nurses.
semantic_expansions: 在旁边：紧挨着，位置贴边
并排：两者朝向一致地齐平摆着
共同：与人肩并肩做同一件事
collocations: alongside sth —— 紧靠某物，后直接接名词，不加 of
work alongside sb —— 与某人共事，强调地位相当
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语把 an other 连写而成：an（一个）+ other ← 古英语 ōþer（第二个、别的）← 原始日耳曼语 *antharaz
words.native_definition: one more of the same kind, or a different one
words.core_concept: one more, or one other – 同类里再来一个，或换成别的一个
words.core_image: 杯子空了，他往桌沿一推，服务员又端来一只一样的搁在原处
examples: She poured another cup of tea for him.
That is another matter altogether.
semantic_expansions: 另一个：同类中并列的第二个
再一个：数目上又添一个，样式照旧
别的：性质不同的另一样，不在同一类里
collocations: another + 数词 + 复数名词 —— 再…个，如 another two weeks
one after another —— 一个接一个，指依次不断
one another —— 彼此，三人以上互相时多用它
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 得名于英格兰 Gloucestershire 的 Badminton House（庄园名，源自古英语地名 Badimincgtun：Baduhelm 一族的庄地），1870 年代宾客在此打此球戏
words.native_definition: a game in which players hit a light shuttlecock over a net
words.core_concept: a feathered cork knocked over a net – 插羽毛的软木被拍过网
words.core_image: 插着羽毛的软木过网就慢下来，忽然往下坠，接的人拍子探到脚边才够着
examples: They play badminton in the school hall.
He bought a new badminton racket.
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 beforan（be 在 + foran 前面 ← fore 前）
words.native_definition: earlier than something, or in front of something
words.core_concept: earlier in the line – 在次序上排在前头
words.core_image: 名单上他的名字排在那人上头，会还没开他就先进了屋，坐在最靠门的位子
examples: Finish the report before Friday morning.
He stood before the whole class.
semantic_expansions: 在…以前：时间上排在某事之先
在…前面：位置上处于某物的正前方
以前：作副词时指从前，不带宾语
collocations: before doing sth —— 在做某事之前，接动名词
it was not long before... —— 不久就…，从句用过去时
before long —— 不久以后，作时间状语
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 英语 begin 加 -ing 构成，begin ← 古英语 beginnan（be- 加强 + ginnan 着手）
words.native_definition: the first part or the starting point of something
words.core_concept: the point a thing starts from – 一样东西起头的那一点
words.core_image: 书翻开第一页只有一句话，后面三百页全是从这句话生出来的
examples: The beginning of the film is very slow.
From the beginning she knew the risk.
semantic_expansions: 开始：事情动起来的那一刻
开端：整段过程最前面的一截，后面由它生出
起初：回头看时最早的那一段时间
collocations: at the beginning of sth —— 在某事的开头，指时间或位置
from the beginning —— 从一开始，强调自最初起
in the beginning —— 起初、当初，与后来相对，后不接 of
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 bilooghe（bi 靠 + lowe 低处 ← 古诺斯语 lágr 低）
words.native_definition: at or to a lower level than something
words.core_concept: at a lower level than the thing named – 比所说的那样东西位置更低
words.core_image: 水线离甲板还有一尺，从栏杆往下探头，桨叶一半浸在暗处
examples: The village lies below the old castle.
Temperatures fell below zero last night.
semantic_expansions: 在…下面：位置处在某物之下
低于：数值不到某个界
在下文：文件里指后面的段落，与上文相对
collocations: below zero —— 零度以下，说温度时的固定说法
see below —— 见下文，文件里指向后面的内容
below average —— 低于平均水平，与 above average 相对
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 betera（good 的比较级）← 原始日耳曼语 *batizō ← *bat-（好、有益）
words.native_definition: of higher quality than something else, or in an improved state
words.core_concept: standing higher than the one compared – 比拿来比的那个高出一截
words.core_image: 两碗面并排放着，右边那碗汤更清、浇头压得更满，他伸手端了右边的
examples: This road is better than the old one.
She felt better after taking the pills.
semantic_expansions: 更好的：两者相比质量占上
更好地：作副词时指做得更到位
好转的：身体或局面比先前有起色
collocations: had better do sth —— 最好做某事，后接动词原形不带 to
be better off doing sth —— 做某事境况会更好
know better than to do sth —— 明理而不至于做某事
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
